name: check-ownership
title: Check what the user already owns
summary: Mark search results as owned or not, or check one listing

steps.why: Search and mark each row owned or not in one go (about 1 request per 24 rows)

steps.check: owned; state.ownership[].name shows the licence tier (e.g. Personal)

notes: For several UIDs use ownership --batch a,b,c or --from-stdin, not a loop: one Fab session for the whole batch.
An unknown UID answers owned:false rather than an error.
